criterion: Starting from the launcher with authorised access, opening GIS displays a settled map with visible zoom-in and reset-map-view controls.
steps_taken: Navigated to the exact launcher URL and waited for the visible authenticated launcher.
Captured criterion 1 initial launcher PNG; first save returned ENOENT because the staging screenshot folder did not exist. Created the folder and successfully retried the save before interacting.
Selected Open GIS and waited for Loading map to disappear.
Observed a settled map covering Ireland, Great Britain and part of northern France, with a 100 km scale.
Inspected the visible map controls and accessible button names: Reset north and flatten map, Map style, Zoom in, Zoom out. Captured final GIS state and read current URL.
reason: GIS and zoom-in are available, but no visible control for resetting the geographic extent/default zoom is exposed. The only reset is labelled 'Reset north and flatten map', which describes orientation. The required reset-map-view feature is unavailable for this criterion; its behavior was not assumed or substituted.

criterion: From the recorded initial map view, selecting zoom-in once produces a visibly closer settled map view while the GIS workspace and map controls remain available.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL, waited for the visible launcher and captured criterion 2 initial PNG.
Selected Open GIS, waited for Loading map to disappear and captured the initial GIS map before zoom.

Selected Zoom in exactly once, waited two seconds and verified the settled map scale changed from 100 km to 50 km; Ireland and the Irish Sea occupied a larger share of the view with more detailed place and road labels.
Captured the zoomed transition and a separate final PNG before cleanup; GIS workspace, Zoom in, Zoom out, Map style and orientation reset remained visible. Read current URL at final state.

Attempted cleanup with Zoom out; tool timed out because the Zoom in tooltip intercepted pointer events. The file named criterion-2-cleanup-default.png records this unsuccessful cleanup and still shows 50 km, not a restored default.
Moved pointer to Search Map, waited one second, selected Zoom out once successfully and verified 100 km returned. Captured criterion-2-cleanup-restored.png showing the default geographic coverage.
reason: Direct before/after PNG evidence shows a visibly closer settled map after one zoom-in. Cleanup recovered successfully after the tooltip interception; the map was restored.

criterion: After zooming, selecting reset map view returns the map to its initial default geographic extent and scale as visibly demonstrated, while the GIS controls remain available.
steps_taken: Navigated independently to the exact launcher URL, waited for the visible launcher and captured criterion 3 initial PNG.
Selected Open GIS, waited for Loading map to disappear and recorded this criterion's default geographic coverage and 100 km scale before zoom.
Selected Zoom in once, waited two seconds and verified the settled 50 km scale.
Inspected available controls and hovered the orientation reset. Its visible tooltip and accessible name were 'Reset north and flatten map'; no extent/default-view reset control was present.
Captured separate final PNG at the zoomed blocker state and read current URL. Did not substitute orientation reset for the unavailable extent-reset action.
Moved pointer to Search Map, waited one second, selected Zoom out once and verified 100 km and the initial default geographic coverage returned. Captured cleanup separately.
reason: Cannot perform the required geographic-extent reset action because no matching visible control is available. The orientation reset label does not establish an extent-reset feature. No test data was needed; this is a missing control prerequisite, not a data or authentication failure. The map was restored to its initial default coverage using Zoom out for cleanup only.
